records.title: Graph Neural Networks for Link Prediction with Subgraph Sketching
records.read_kind: retained conclusion and narrow source revisit
records.saved_takeaway: Independent predictors share BUDDY deterministic cache too; active port modulates every learned map and retains private nonlinear endpoint/structural paths. Equal complete cached inputs imply indistinguishable query scores. No useful collab collision or predictive gain measured.

records.title: Neural Common Neighbor with Completion for Link Prediction
records.read_kind: retained primary summary and saved pinned decoder-source changed-question revisit
records.saved_takeaway: Depth-1 NCNC separately scores residual-neighbor missing links under no_grad, clamps scores, makes weighted sparse feature sums and applies nonlinear decoding. Private weights versus weights pooled after the clamp is a meaningful source-defined contrast. NCNC itself is the direct completion prior; independent native members already retain their own pairing.
